title: Sausages
description: Sausages, bread with sausages and the Sausage Cutter are now available for your Minecraft world!
body:
**Did you ever feel the need for a new food source and a new weapon? Then you’ve found the right mod. Use the new weapon, the -Sausage Cutter- to obliterate your enemies.**

**This mod adds:**

**-Sausages** of several types: Raw, Beef, Mutton, Chicken and Pork, made by crafting with the respective meat and the Sausage Cutter.\
**-Bread** with sausages of the same types as mentioned for the sausages.\
**-Sliced bread**, that is used to craft Bread with Sausages.\
**-Sausage** Cutter is a fast small blade with a sweeping attack (like a Sword), it is also used to cut bread and meat.\
**-Sharp Blade** is used to craft a Sausage Cutter.\
**-Sausager villager** trading various modded items.\
**-Dark Lonely House** a structure with a double chest full of loot. Found in various biomes.\
**-Cutting Bord** the workstation for the new villager.\

 
# Troubleshooting/Suggestions
If you've found any bugs or have any suggestions for improving, please join the discussion on curseforge. \
This is the first mod I have made and published.  \
